items.item: STS3215 servos, 12 V 30 kg version (C018), 6-pack with controller board
items.note: ORDERED 11 Nov 2026, arriving Wed 18 Nov. Feetech STS3215 Smart Servo Set, pack of 6 with controller board, sold by Amazon EU (VAT included, free returns). Listing confirms 12 V recommended, 30 kg·cm at 12 V, gear ratio 1:345 (= C018). Chosen over ArmDojo (about £132 with import VAT, 8–14 working days from Singapore) for simplicity: no customs, faster, easy returns. Compared 11 Nov: no UK shop stocks singles at a sensible price (RC Hobby-Models minimum 11 units; RobotShop UK restocking, £61 delivery; Unmanned Tech kit out of stock). Avoid 7.4 V / 19 kg listings (e.g. the £22.99 Waveshare ST3215) and Hiwonder HX-30HM (different protocol).

Included in the Amazon servo 6-pack. One board drives all six servos, daisy-chained; the laptop runs the software over USB. Check which board it is when it arrives (Waveshare Bus Servo Adapter A or similar); the sim's Real driver assumes the Feetech protocol over USB serial.
Optional, for longer joint runs. Each servo already comes with a 15 cm cable; check what's in the box first.
Match the driver board's USB port; may be in the box.

items.item: 12 V power supply, at least 5 A (100–240 V input)
items.note: Not in the servo pack. Check home first: label must say 12 V and 5 A or more, 5.5 × 2.1 mm barrel plug, centre-positive. Otherwise buy on Amazon UK. 100–240 V input so it works in Brazil.
Follower arm needs about 400 g. Weigh the current spool first (subtract about 230 g for an empty plastic spool). Print one test part before the rest.
GTMax3D is an authorised Bambu Lab reseller in Brazil. Other shops: bambulab.com/pt-br/where-to-buy. Pending a chat with Mum.
Bulky and generic, so buy locally.
